subject: Your 3AM spiral has a blueprint
preview_text: Most people do this one thing wrong at 3AM. Here's the fix that 600+ users swear by.
body_paragraphs: Remember that 3AM moment last week when your brain decided to replay every memory? Yeah, I've been there. But here's what nobody tells you: that spiral follows a pattern, and once you see it, you can hack it.

I spent 14 days studying what happens in the app during those hours. Turns out, the first 10 minutes of a spiral are the most dangerous — your brain's still foggy, and you're vulnerable to old habits. But if you intercept it with the right move, you can flip the script.

That's why we built Emergency Mode in Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy. It's not just a panic button. It's a guided sequence that catches you at the exact moment you're about to text your ex or stalk their profile. One tap, and it walks you through a 3-minute grounding exercise that rewires your response. Users who use it report 40% faster recovery.

Open the app tonight. Go to the home screen and swipe left until you see the red icon. That's your 3AM blueprint. Tap it once, even if you're not spiraling — just to see it's there. P.S. The real magic happens when you use it three nights in a row. That's when the pattern breaks for good.
